title: Disappearance of Sharon, the space-kid psychic

tellings.quote: And she just disappeared. And everyone who knew her back then was like, you know, it would be amazing if you found her because she They're convinced that she was pulled into a you know, Stranger Things Montauk project type project where like she was the real deal and she was sort of pulled into a project like that.

plain: A researcher named Greg says that a girl named Sharon was one of the "space kids", young people said to have psychic gifts who were studied by Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychic phenomena, in the late 1970s and early 1980s in the United States. According to Greg, Sharon simply disappeared, and the people who knew her then are convinced she was the real deal and was pulled into a secret government project, like the ones in the TV show Stranger Things or the legend of Montauk. If true, it would mean a gifted child was taken into hidden psychic research.
